name: Clonidine
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.effect: Sinus bradycardia needing hospitalization and pacemakers reported (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Digoxin, beta-blockers, other calcium channel blockers
key_interactions.effect: Additive slowing of the sinus node and AV conduction (label).

key_interactions.action: The clonidine dose may need to be increased.

key_interactions.effect: Orthostatic hypotension, dizziness and fatigue may appear or worsen (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Alcohol, barbiturates and other sedating drugs
key_interactions.action: Counsel the patient; use with caution.
